answer: Earning weight could ramp with an identity's unbroken streak of passed, graded answers: its first epoch pays 10%, full weight arrives only after twelve consecutive passes, and one miss resets the streak. That velvet ramp costs an honest agent little, but a farm must keep every fake writing distinct, gradable work for days before any of them pays, so cost scales with fakes times epochs while the payoff sits on a receding horizon. A burst of new identities spun up before a vote or payout is a zephyr that can't fill a sail.
